ex.en: The school is five kilometers from my home.
ex.zh: 學校離我家五公里。

ex.en: It is three kilometers from here to the bank.
ex.zh: 從這裡到銀行有三公里。

ex.en: This car can go thirteen kilometers for every liter of gasoline.
ex.zh: 這輛車每公升汽油可以跑十三公里。

kilometer.en: a unit of distance equal to 1,000 meters

ex.en: Don't forget to take the first-aid kit.
ex.zh: 別忘了帶急救箱。

ex.en: I keep a tool kit in the car.
ex.zh: 我在車上放了一套工具組。

ex.en: The welcome kit includes a map and a badge.
ex.zh: 迎賓包裡有一張地圖和一個名牌。

kit.en: a set of things needed for a particular purpose

ex.en: I have gained two kilograms this summer.
ex.zh: 這個夏天我胖了兩公斤。

ex.en: How many kilograms did you lose last month?
ex.zh: 你上個月瘦了幾公斤？

ex.en: Rice is sold by the kilogram.
ex.zh: 米是按公斤賣的。

kilogram.en: a unit of weight equal to 1,000 grams

ex.en: That child may have been kidnapped on his way home.
ex.zh: 那個孩子可能在回家路上被綁架了。

ex.en: He is accused of kidnapping.
ex.zh: 他被控綁架。

kidnap.en: to take someone away by force and hold them, often to ask for money

killer.zh: 殺手；致命的東西（疾病等）

ex.en: Heart disease is the number one killer in many countries.
ex.zh: 在許多國家，心臟病是頭號殺手。

ex.en: Stress can be a silent killer.
ex.zh: 壓力可能是隱形殺手。

killer.en: a person who murders, or something such as an illness that causes death

ex.en: The camera is the killer feature of this phone.
ex.zh: 相機是這支手機的殺手級功能。

ex.en: That was a killer presentation!
ex.zh: 那場簡報太精彩了！

ex.en: How many kinds of birds are in your backyard?
ex.zh: 你家後院有幾種鳥？

ex.en: I don't want to buy this kind of sofa.
ex.zh: 我不想買這種沙發。

ex.en: There are all kinds of people in the world.
ex.zh: 世界上什麼樣的人都有。

kind.en: a group of things or people that are similar

ex.en: He was kind enough to lend me some money.
ex.zh: 他很好心，借了我一些錢。

ex.en: Tom is one of the kindest people I know.
ex.zh: 湯姆是我認識最善良的人之一。

kind.en: friendly, generous and caring toward others

ex.en: I'm kind of tired today.
ex.zh: 我今天有點累。

ex.en: The movie was kind of boring.
ex.zh: 那部電影有點無聊。

kind.en: to some degree, but not completely

ex.en: I had chicken pox when I was a kid.
ex.zh: 我小時候得過水痘。

ex.en: I brought up two kids all on my own.
ex.zh: 我一個人把兩個小孩養大。

ex.en: Because our kids got married, we are now in-laws.
ex.zh: 我們的孩子結婚了，所以我們現在是親家。

ex.en: Tom realized that Mary wasn't kidding.
ex.zh: 湯姆發現瑪莉不是在開玩笑。

ex.en: Are you kidding me?
ex.zh: 你在開玩笑吧？

ex.en: Don't worry, I'm just kidding!
ex.zh: 別擔心，我只是開玩笑的啦！

kid.en: to say something untrue as a joke

ex.en: The volcano erupted suddenly, killing many people.
ex.zh: 火山突然噴發，造成許多人死亡。

ex.en: Most people killed by smoking were not heavy smokers.
ex.zh: 大多數因吸菸而死的人並不是老菸槍。

ex.en: Don't kill too many birds and animals on earth.
ex.zh: 不要過度捕殺地球上的鳥類和動物。

kill.en: to cause a person or animal to die

ex.en: I read a magazine to kill time.
ex.zh: 我看雜誌打發時間。

ex.en: We killed time at a café before the movie.
ex.zh: 電影開演前我們在咖啡店打發時間。

kill.en: to do something to pass time while waiting

kill.zh: kill two birds with one stone：一舉兩得

ex.en: That way I kill two birds with one stone.
ex.zh: 這樣我就一舉兩得了。

ex.en: Let's kill two birds with one stone and visit the client on the way.
ex.zh: 我們順路拜訪客戶，一舉兩得。

kill.en: to solve two problems with a single action

ex.en: If you buy me an ice cream, I'll kiss you.
ex.zh: 如果你買冰淇淋給我，我就親你一下。

ex.en: At the end of the ceremony, the new couple kissed.
ex.zh: 典禮結束時，新人互相親吻。

kiss.en: to touch someone with your lips to show love or greeting

ex.en: The grand prize is a kiss from the princess.
ex.zh: 頭獎是公主的一個吻。

ex.en: She gave her son a goodnight kiss.
ex.zh: 她給兒子一個晚安吻。

kiss.en: a touch with the lips to show love or greeting

ex.en: He is kicking me!
ex.zh: 他在踢我！

ex.en: He kicked the ball into the goal.
ex.zh: 他把球踢進球門。

kick.en: to hit something with your foot

ex.en: The coin toss decides who will kick off the match.
ex.zh: 擲硬幣決定由哪一隊開球。

ex.en: The conference kicks off on Monday.
ex.zh: 研討會星期一開幕。

kick.en: to begin, especially a game or an event

ex.en: They kicked him out of the disco without any explanation.
ex.zh: 他們沒有任何解釋就把他趕出了舞廳。

ex.en: He was kicked out of the team.
ex.zh: 他被踢出了球隊。

kick.en: to force someone to leave a place or group

ex.en: Once there lived a king whose name was Alfred.
ex.zh: 從前有一位名叫阿佛烈的國王。

ex.en: The king will appear in person tomorrow evening.
ex.zh: 國王明晚會親自現身。

ex.en: When I grow up, I want to be king.
ex.zh: 我長大後想當國王。

king.en: a man who rules a country because of his royal family

ex.en: He needs a kidney transplant.
ex.zh: 他需要腎臟移植。

ex.en: Drinking enough water is good for your kidneys.
ex.zh: 喝足夠的水對腎臟有益。

kidney.en: one of two body parts that clean the blood and make urine

ex.en: I can hear Tom in the kitchen washing dishes.
ex.zh: 我聽到湯姆在廚房洗碗的聲音。

ex.en: Tell the children to stay out of the kitchen.
ex.zh: 告訴孩子別進廚房。

ex.en: American kitchens are much bigger than Japanese ones.
ex.zh: 美式廚房比日式廚房大得多。

kitchen.en: a room where food is prepared and cooked

ex.en: The teachers are playing games with students in the kindergarten.
ex.zh: 幼兒園裡，老師正在帶領小朋友們嘻戲。

ex.en: She is a child-care worker in a kindergarten.
ex.zh: 她是幼兒園裡的保育員。

ex.en: Layla is Sami's new kindergarten teacher.
ex.zh: 蕾拉是薩米新的幼稚園老師。

kindergarten.en: a school for very young children before primary school

ex.en: All her kin came from different cities for the wedding.
ex.zh: 她所有的親戚都從各地趕來參加婚禮。

ex.en: The hospital needs to contact the patient's next of kin.
ex.zh: 醫院需要聯絡病人的最近親屬。

ex.en: Kindly confirm the delivery address by noon.
ex.zh: 請於中午前確認送貨地址。

ex.en: The receptionist kindly helped our visitors.
ex.zh: 接待人員親切地協助訪客。

kindly.en: used to ask politely, or in a friendly and caring way

ex.en: Buy your transit pass at the kiosk beside the station entrance.
ex.zh: 請在車站入口旁的小亭購買交通月票。

ex.en: Passengers checked in at a self-service kiosk.
ex.zh: 乘客在自助服務機辦理報到。

kiosk.en: a small booth selling things, or a machine people use to get a service

ex.en: The prince lived in a small kingdom by the sea.
ex.zh: 王子住在海邊的一個小王國。

ex.en: The United Kingdom is made up of four countries.
ex.zh: 聯合王國由四個國家組成。

ex.en: Mushrooms do not belong to the plant kingdom.
ex.zh: 蕈菇不屬於植物界。

ex.en: Whales are part of the animal kingdom.
ex.zh: 鯨魚屬於動物界。

ex.en: The school is two kilometres from my house.
ex.zh: 學校距離我家兩公里。

ex.en: She runs five kilometres every morning.
ex.zh: 她每天早上跑五公里。

killing.zh: 殺、使死亡（kill 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The cold weather is killing the plants in the garden.
ex.zh: 寒冷的天氣正在讓花園裡的植物枯死。

ex.en: Too much stress is killing his health.
ex.zh: 過多的壓力正在摧毀他的健康。

ex.en: The police are investigating the killing of a shop owner.
ex.zh: 警方正在調查一起店老闆遭殺害的案件。

ex.en: The newspaper reported on the killing for several days.
ex.zh: 報紙連續幾天報導了這起殺人案。

ex.en: My feet are killing me after the long walk.
ex.zh: 走了這麼久的路，我的腳痛得要命。

ex.en: The hike up the mountain was a killing climb.
ex.zh: 那趟上山的健行爬得累死人。

kim.zh: 金姆（常見的人名或姓氏）

ex.en: Kim is studying to become a nurse.
ex.zh: 金姆正在讀書準備成為護理師。

ex.en: I saved a seat for Kim at the front of the room.
ex.zh: 我幫金姆在教室前面留了一個位子。

ex.en: The children flew a kite in the park on a windy day.
ex.zh: 孩子們在有風的日子裡到公園放風箏。

ex.en: My kite got stuck in a tall tree.
ex.zh: 我的風箏卡在一棵高樹上。

kite.zh: 像風箏一樣飛、輕快移動

ex.en: The little boat kited across the waves in the strong wind.
ex.zh: 那艘小船在強風中像風箏般輕快地掠過浪面。

ex.en: Sea birds kite above the cliffs on the wind.
ex.zh: 海鳥乘著風在懸崖上方像風箏般盤旋。

ex.en: Thank you for your kindness when I was sick.
ex.zh: 謝謝你在我生病時的善意關照。

ex.en: A small act of kindness can brighten someone's day.
ex.zh: 一個小小的善舉就能讓某人的一天變得明亮。

ex.en: The kidnapping shocked the whole town.
ex.zh: 這起綁架案震驚了整個小鎮。

ex.en: Police are investigating a kidnapping case.
ex.zh: 警方正在調查一起綁架案。

ex.en: Kinship is very important in many small villages.
ex.zh: 在許多小村莊裡，親屬關係非常重要。

ex.en: The family tree shows the kinship between cousins and uncles.
ex.zh: 這張家族樹顯示了堂表兄弟姊妹與叔伯之間的親屬關係。

kinda.zh: 有點、算是（kind of 的口語）

ex.en: I'm kinda tired, so let's stay home tonight.
ex.zh: 我有點累，所以今晚我們待在家吧。

ex.en: The movie was kinda boring, but the ending was great.
ex.zh: 這部電影有點無聊，不過結尾很棒。

ex.en: She kinda likes him, but she won't admit it.
ex.zh: 她算是喜歡他，只是不肯承認。

ex.en: The kitten curled up on my lap and fell asleep.
ex.zh: 小貓蜷縮在我的腿上睡著了。

ex.en: We adopted a tiny kitten from the shelter.
ex.zh: 我們從收容所領養了一隻小小貓。

ex.en: Many kings once ruled over small lands in Europe.
ex.zh: 許多國王曾統治歐洲的小塊土地。

ex.en: The museum has portraits of kings from different centuries.
ex.zh: 博物館收藏了不同世紀國王的肖像。

ex.en: Kingston is the capital and largest city of Jamaica.
ex.zh: 金斯敦是牙買加的首都，也是最大的城市。

ex.en: The flight from Miami to Kingston takes about an hour and a half.
ex.zh: 從邁阿密飛往金斯敦大約要一個半小時。

ex.en: I bought a kilo of apples at the market.
ex.zh: 我在市場買了一公斤蘋果。

ex.en: He lost three kilos in two months.
ex.zh: 他兩個月瘦了三公斤。

killed.zh: 殺死；使喪生（kill 的過去式）

ex.en: The storm killed the plants in our garden.
ex.zh: 暴風雨讓我們花園裡的植物死了。

ex.en: Two people were killed in the accident.
ex.zh: 兩個人在那場事故中喪生。

ex.en: The number of killed and injured is still unknown.
ex.zh: 死傷人數仍不清楚。

ex.en: The killed soldiers were honored at the ceremony.
ex.zh: 儀式上向陣亡的士兵致敬。

ex.en: The kickoff of the football game is at seven o'clock.
ex.zh: 足球賽七點開球。

ex.en: We got to the stadium an hour before kickoff.
ex.zh: 我們在開球前一小時抵達球場。

ex.en: The team held a kickoff meeting for the new project.
ex.zh: 團隊為新專案召開了啟動會議。

ex.en: The festival's kickoff will be a parade on Friday.
ex.zh: 慶典的開幕將是週五的遊行。

ex.en: The potter put the clay bowls into the kiln.
ex.zh: 陶藝家把黏土碗放進窯裡。

ex.en: Bricks are baked in a kiln until they are hard.
ex.zh: 磚頭要放在窯裡燒到變硬。

ex.en: A bright blue kingfisher sat on a branch above the river.
ex.zh: 一隻亮藍色的翠鳥停在河上方的樹枝上。

ex.en: The kingfisher dived into the water and caught a small fish.
ex.zh: 翠鳥俯衝入水，抓到一條小魚。

ex.en: The kicker scored the winning goal from far away.
ex.zh: 那位踢球員從遠處踢進了致勝的一球。

ex.en: Our team needs a better kicker for penalty shots.
ex.zh: 我們隊需要一個更厲害的點球射手。

ex.en: I had a slice of kiwi with my yogurt.
ex.zh: 我的優格裡加了一片奇異果。

ex.en: A kiwi is green inside and has small black seeds.
ex.zh: 奇異果裡面是綠色的，有小小的黑籽。

ex.en: The kiwi is a bird that cannot fly.
ex.zh: 奇異鳥是一種不會飛的鳥。

ex.en: We saw a kiwi at a nighttime bird house in New Zealand.
ex.zh: 我們在紐西蘭的夜間鳥館看到了一隻奇異鳥。

ex.en: My roommate is a Kiwi from Auckland.
ex.zh: 我的室友是來自奧克蘭的紐西蘭人。

ex.en: The Kiwis cheered loudly for their rugby team.
ex.zh: 紐西蘭人為他們的橄欖球隊大聲加油。

ex.en: The couple were kissing under the tree.
ex.zh: 那對情侶正在樹下親吻。

ex.en: She was kissing her baby goodnight.
ex.zh: 她正在親吻寶寶道晚安。

ex.en: Kissing on the cheek is a common greeting in some countries.
ex.zh: 在一些國家，親吻臉頰是常見的問候方式。

ex.en: The movie ended with a kissing scene.
ex.zh: 這部電影以一場親吻戲收尾。

ex.en: Police arrested the kidnapper two days after the report.
ex.zh: 警方在接獲報案兩天後逮捕了綁匪。

ex.en: The film's kidnapper demands money from the family.
ex.zh: 電影裡的綁匪向那家人勒索金錢。

ex.en: Our kitty likes to sleep on the sofa.
ex.zh: 我們家的小貓喜歡睡在沙發上。

ex.en: She called the kitty over with a soft voice.
ex.zh: 她輕聲把小貓叫過來。

ex.en: Each of us put ten dollars into the kitty for snacks.
ex.zh: 我們每人拿十元放進公基金來買零食。

ex.en: The office kitty pays for birthday cakes.
ex.zh: 辦公室的公基金用來買生日蛋糕。

ex.en: A moving ball has kinetic energy.
ex.zh: 移動中的球具有動能。

ex.en: The artist makes kinetic sculptures that move in the wind.
ex.zh: 這位藝術家製作會隨風動的動態雕塑。

ex.en: Rudyard Kipling was a British writer who won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1907.
ex.zh: 魯德亞德·吉卜林是一位英國作家，在一九〇七年獲得諾貝爾文學獎。

ex.en: Kipling wrote The Jungle Book, a collection of stories about animals.
ex.zh: 吉卜林寫了《叢林奇譚》，是一部動物故事集。

kidding.zh: 開玩笑（kid 的現在分詞）

ex.en: Are you kidding? That can't be true!
ex.zh: 你在開玩笑嗎？那不可能是真的！

ex.en: I'm only kidding, so don't take it seriously.
ex.zh: 我只是開玩笑，別放在心上。

ex.en: She wore a beautiful silk kimono to the tea ceremony.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件漂亮的絲質和服參加茶道。

ex.en: A traditional kimono can take years to make by hand.
ex.zh: 一件傳統和服可能要花好幾年手工製作。

ex.en: Kiev is the capital of Ukraine.
ex.zh: 基輔是烏克蘭的首都。

ex.en: The Dnieper River flows through Kiev.
ex.zh: 聶伯河流經基輔。

ex.en: He is a distant kinsman of the family, so he was invited to the wedding.
ex.zh: 他是這個家族的遠房親戚，所以受邀參加婚禮。

ex.en: The old farmer left his land to a kinsman who lived nearby.
ex.zh: 那位老農夫把土地留給住在附近的一位親戚。

ex.en: He used dry leaves to kindle the fire.
ex.zh: 他用乾樹葉來生火。

ex.en: It is hard to kindle a campfire in the rain.
ex.zh: 在雨中很難點燃營火。

ex.en: The teacher's story kindled my interest in science.
ex.zh: 老師的故事激起了我對科學的興趣。

ex.en: The old photos kindled happy memories.
ex.zh: 那些舊照片喚起了美好的回憶。

ex.en: The prince was not ready to take on kingship.
ex.zh: 王子還沒準備好承擔王權。

ex.en: Kingship passed from father to son for many generations.
ex.zh: 王位好幾代都是父傳子。

ex.en: There is a kink in the garden hose, so no water comes out.
ex.zh: 水管有一處打結了，所以水流不出來。

ex.en: She brushed the kinks out of her long hair.
ex.zh: 她把長髮裡打結的地方梳開。

ex.en: We still need to work out a few kinks in the system.
ex.zh: 我們還需要解決系統中的一些小毛病。

ex.en: The team fixed the last kink before the launch.
ex.zh: 團隊在上線前修好了最後一個小問題。

ex.en: The official was caught taking a kickback from a contractor.
ex.zh: 那名官員被抓到收取承包商的回扣。

ex.en: Paying kickbacks to win contracts is against the law.
ex.zh: 為了拿到合約而給回扣是違法的。

ex.en: We became friends at once because we were kindred spirits.
ex.zh: 我們一見如故，因為我們是志同道合的人。

ex.en: Cats and lions are kindred animals, even if they look very different.
ex.zh: 貓和獅子是近緣動物，即使牠們看起來很不一樣。

ex.en: He grew up far away from his kindred and rarely saw them.
ex.zh: 他在遠離親人的地方長大，很少見到他們。

ex.en: The whole kindred gathered for the wedding in the village.
ex.zh: 全家族的人都聚在村子裡參加婚禮。

kitsch.zh: 媚俗的東西；庸俗藝術品

ex.en: The gift shop was full of cheap kitsch for tourists.
ex.zh: 那家紀念品店裡擺滿了給觀光客的廉價媚俗小物。

ex.en: Some people love kitsch, while others find it ugly.
ex.zh: 有些人喜歡媚俗的玩意兒，有些人則覺得很醜。

ex.en: The police arrested the kingpin of the smuggling ring.
ex.zh: 警方逮捕了走私集團的首腦。

ex.en: She is the kingpin of our department; nothing happens without her.
ex.zh: 她是我們部門的關鍵人物，沒有她什麼事都做不成。

ex.en: The piper wore a kilt and played the bagpipes.
ex.zh: 風笛手穿著蘇格蘭裙吹奏風笛。

ex.en: He bought a tartan kilt in Edinburgh.
ex.zh: 他在愛丁堡買了一條格紋蘇格蘭裙。

ex.en: He had a kipper and toast for breakfast.
ex.zh: 他早餐吃了燻鯡魚配吐司。

ex.en: A kipper is a herring that has been salted and smoked.
ex.zh: 燻鯡魚是經過鹽漬和煙燻的鯡魚。

ex.en: The restaurant has a kiddy menu with small portions.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳有份量較小的兒童菜單。

ex.en: He pointed to the kiddy pool and told us to stay out.
ex.zh: 他指著兒童池，叫我們不要進去。

ex.en: The park has a kiddie ride near the entrance.
ex.zh: 公園入口附近有一項兒童遊樂設施。

ex.en: They ordered a kiddie meal with a small toy.
ex.zh: 他們點了附小玩具的兒童餐。

kibbutz.zh: 基布茲（以色列的集體農場）

ex.en: A kibbutz is a farm community in Israel where members share work.
ex.zh: 基布茲是以色列的一種集體農場社區，成員一起分擔工作。

ex.en: He spent a summer working on a kibbutz.
ex.zh: 他有一個夏天在基布茲工作。

ex.en: The soccer match kicks off at seven tonight.
ex.zh: 足球比賽今晚七點開踢。

ex.en: We will kick off the meeting with a short video.
ex.zh: 我們會用一段短片揭開會議的序幕。

kick off.en: to begin an event or a match

ex.en: The club kicked him out for breaking the rules.
ex.zh: 俱樂部因為他違反規定而把他開除。

ex.en: My roommate kicked out the stray cat.
ex.zh: 我的室友把那隻流浪貓趕了出去。

kick out.en: to force someone to leave a place or group
